name: prdb
description: Manage your PRDB library and read private papers with your agent.

interface.longDescription: Browser registration handoffs, OAuth identity, private PDF transfer from explicitly granted local files, Library and daily actions, exact highlights/comments, page images and private reviews. Public reviews require exact-body owner confirmation in PRDB; experimental native UI approval remains disabled pending client verification.
defaultPrompt: Read this paper with PRDB and save an evidence-backed private review draft.
